entries.name: x-formspec-email
entries.description: Email address with RFC 5321 simplified validation. Extends string with a pattern that covers the vast majority of real-world addresses without rejecting uncommon but valid ones.

entries.name: x-formspec-phone
entries.description: International phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234). Stored as a string to preserve the leading plus sign and any leading zeros in country codes.

entries.name: x-formspec-phone-nanp
entries.description: North American phone number in (###) ###-#### display format. For US/Canada/Caribbean forms where E.164 is unnecessarily strict. Stored with punctuation for human readability.

entries.name: x-formspec-postal-code-us
entries.description: US ZIP code in 5-digit or ZIP+4 format. Stored as string to preserve leading zeros (e.g. 01234).

entries.name: x-formspec-percentage
entries.description: Percentage value stored as a decimal number 0–100 (not 0–1). Renderers should display a '%' suffix. Precision defaults to 2 decimal places.

entries.name: x-formspec-currency-usd
entries.description: US Dollar amount stored as a non-negative decimal with 2-digit precision. For forms that always use USD and don't need the full money composite type.

entries.name: x-formspec-ssn
entries.description: US Social Security Number in ###-##-#### format. Renderers should mask display (showing only last 4 digits) for privacy. Stored with hyphens.

entries.name: x-formspec-ein
entries.description: US Employer Identification Number in ##-####### format.

entries.name: x-formspec-credit-card
entries.description: Credit/debit card number stored as digits only (no spaces or hyphens). Renderers should format with spaces for readability. Validated by length (13–19 digits) and Luhn checksum.

entries.name: x-formspec-color-hex
entries.description: Hex color code in #RRGGBB or #RGB format. Renderers may present a color picker.

entries.name: x-formspec-slug
entries.description: URL-safe slug: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens. Must start and end with a letter or digit. Useful for identifiers, usernames, and URL paths.

entries.name: x-formspec-ipv4
entries.description: IPv4 address in dotted-decimal notation (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Pattern validates format; does not restrict to routable addresses.

entries.name: x-formspec-url
entries.description: HTTPS URL with domain validation. Pattern enforces https:// scheme, valid hostname labels, optional port, and optional path. Use a manual constraint with matches() if http:// is also needed.

entries.name: x-formspec-luhn
entries.description: Validates that a numeric string passes the Luhn checksum algorithm. Used for credit card numbers, IMEI numbers, Canadian SINs, and other identifiers that embed a check digit.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The numeric string to validate (digits only, no spaces or hyphens).

entries.name: x-formspec-age
entries.description: Calculates age in whole years from a birth date to today (or an optional reference date). Returns null if the birth date is in the future.

parameters.name: birthDate
parameters.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Optional reference date. Defaults to today() if omitted.

entries.name: x-formspec-mask
entries.description: Masks a string value for display, revealing only the last N characters and replacing the rest with a mask character. Useful for displaying partial SSNs, account numbers, etc.

parameters.name: visibleChars
parameters.description: Number of trailing characters to leave visible.

parameters.name: maskChar
parameters.description: Character to use for masking. Defaults to '*'.

entries.name: x-formspec-common
entries.description: Module bundling the Formspec common extensions — widely useful data types, constraints, and functions that complement the core specification. Renamed from `category: namespace` to `category: module` per ADR 0150 §4.1.

entries.name: x-formspec-plural-category
entries.description: CLDR cardinal plural category function. Returns 'zero', 'one', 'two', 'few', 'many', or 'other' based on CLDR plural rules for the given count and locale. Required for languages with non-trivial plural forms (Arabic, Polish, Czech, etc.).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The numeric value to classify into a plural category.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional BCP 47 locale code. When omitted, uses the active locale.

entries.name: x-formspec-surface
entries.description: Surface composition primitive per ADR 0150 §6 — names routes within an app and binds slots that compose Experience units, Definition forms, module widgets, static content, and nested route references. Closed slot-type taxonomy at v0.1 (5 types per §6.2): definition-form, experience-unit, module-widget, static-content, embed-route. Surface is orthogonal to Screener (§7) — Surface is steady-state inward composition; Screener is one-shot outward routing. Cross-seam: the surface:<route-id> URI scheme in Screener terminal-hops lands inside Surface composition (screener.schema.json:Route.target). Surface document shape lives at schemas/surface.schema.json; semantic lint at crates/formspec-lint/src/pass_surface.rs (E606 SURFACE-ROUTE-UNREACHABLE; E607 SURFACE-SLOT-BINDING-UNRESOLVED).

entries.name: x-formspec-surface-slot-type-definition-form
entries.description: Surface slot-type `definition-form` per ADR 0150 §6.2. Slot binds a Definition form (binding.definitionRef references a bundle Definition by url or in-bundle id). Renders the bound form using the Component+Theme stack.

slotShape.summary: Slot binds a Definition form (binding.definitionRef references a bundle Definition by url or in-bundle id). Renders the bound form using the Component+Theme stack.

entries.name: x-formspec-surface-slot-type-experience-unit
entries.description: Surface slot-type `experience-unit` per ADR 0150 §6.2. Slot binds an Experience unit (binding.unitRef references a units[].id in an Experience document; optional binding.experienceRef disambiguates across multi-Experience bundles).

slotShape.summary: Slot binds an Experience unit (binding.unitRef references a units[].id in an Experience document; optional binding.experienceRef disambiguates across multi-Experience bundles).

entries.name: x-formspec-surface-slot-type-module-widget
entries.description: Surface slot-type `module-widget` per ADR 0150 §6.2. Slot binds a module-supplied widget (binding.moduleId + binding.widgetName + optional binding.config). The module MUST appear in the document's modules[] declaration; widget config is lint-validated against the contributing module's widgetShape.props via E604.

slotShape.summary: Slot binds a module-supplied widget (binding.moduleId + binding.widgetName + optional binding.config). The module MUST appear in the document's modules[] declaration; widget config is lint-validated against the contributing module's widgetShape.props via E604.

entries.name: x-formspec-surface-slot-type-static-content
entries.description: Surface slot-type `static-content` per ADR 0150 §6.2. Slot binds inline literal content (binding.kind ∈ {heading, text, image, divider}, binding.content). The four kinds are the v0.1 closed primitives renderers guarantee without consulting a module.

slotShape.summary: Slot binds inline literal content (binding.kind ∈ {heading, text, image, divider}, binding.content). The four kinds are the v0.1 closed primitives renderers guarantee without consulting a module.

entries.name: x-formspec-surface-slot-type-embed-route
entries.description: Surface slot-type `embed-route` per ADR 0150 §6.2. Slot embeds another route within the same Surface (binding.routeRef references a routes[].id; optional binding.mode names presentation: modal, panel, dialog). Edges in the route-graph for E606 reachability.

slotShape.summary: Slot embeds another route within the same Surface (binding.routeRef references a routes[].id; optional binding.mode names presentation: modal, panel, dialog). Edges in the route-graph for E606 reachability.

entries.name: x-formspec-ai-runtime
entries.description: AI authoring runtime per ADR 0150 §8 + §14 P4. Substrate-supports AI-driven authoring by republishing the 9 baseline ai.* event values (command, suggestion, proposal families — 3 events each) and pinning the runtime contract over P0's substrate carry-points: AuthorActor on every event payload (§5.4 + P0 Task 6 authoredBy field), ChangeSetEntry.valueClass admits 'ai-generated' (§4.5), x-generation provenance carries module + actor (§5.3 + §5.4). The 9 events flow through the EventType `^(ai|user)\.` lane (P0 Task 6 Deviation log); they are NOT in the closed-core enum and do NOT trigger E603 (E603 fires only on `^x-` values). Registry contributions are descriptive metadata for posture admission, AI tooling, and audit consumers — schema validation flows through the EventType `^(ai|user)\.` lane directly. This commit ships the module + command family (3 events); suggestion + proposal families ship in follow-on commits per the §14 P4 one-family-per-commit cadence.

entries.name: x-formspec-ai-runtime-ai-command-issued
entries.description: AI-runtime baseline event `ai.command-issued` per ADR 0150 §8 (command family). An AI agent has issued a kernel command. Recorded synchronously when the agent invokes any kernel operation. Forms the issued-side of the command-completed/command-failed pairing. Source lane: respondent-ledger-event.schema.json $defs.EventType.oneOf — the `^(ai|user)\.` lane (P0 Task 6 Deviation). Per spec §4.1 Rule 1 dotted-translation: original value `ai.command-issued` preserved verbatim in extensions['x-formspec-kind-value'] for AI-tooling resolution.

entries.name: x-formspec-ai-runtime-ai-command-completed
entries.description: AI-runtime baseline event `ai.command-completed` per ADR 0150 §8 (command family). A previously-issued AI command has completed successfully. Payload carries replyToEventId pointing at the ai.command-issued event. Source lane: respondent-ledger-event.schema.json $defs.EventType.oneOf — the `^(ai|user)\.` lane (P0 Task 6 Deviation). Per spec §4.1 Rule 1 dotted-translation: original value `ai.command-completed` preserved verbatim in extensions['x-formspec-kind-value'] for AI-tooling resolution.

entries.name: x-formspec-ai-runtime-ai-command-failed
entries.description: AI-runtime baseline event `ai.command-failed` per ADR 0150 §8 (command family). A previously-issued AI command has failed. Payload carries replyToEventId + an error structure (code, message, optional details). Source lane: respondent-ledger-event.schema.json $defs.EventType.oneOf — the `^(ai|user)\.` lane (P0 Task 6 Deviation). Per spec §4.1 Rule 1 dotted-translation: original value `ai.command-failed` preserved verbatim in extensions['x-formspec-kind-value'] for AI-tooling resolution.
